title: Vampirism Item Blood data map
description: NeoForge data map `vampirism:item_blood` (de.teamlapen.vampirism.common.datamaps.ItemBlood). File location: data/<namespace>/data_maps/item/item_blood.json. Sets how much impure blood (mB) the Blood Grinder produces from an item; 0 = not grindable.

replace.description: If true, clears all previously loaded entries before applying `values`.

values.description: Maps an item id (or a `#item_tag`) to a blood entry.

remove.description: Item ids (or `#item_tags`) to remove from the merged map.

idOrTag.description: A namespaced id, or a tag reference prefixed with `#`.

entry.description: mB of impure blood produced per item. Bare integer or an object.

blood.description: mB of impure blood produced per item. 0 = not grindable.
